this paper introduces a novel distributed privacy framework for the Internet of Things, which is based on the use of privacy policies, which are automatically generated and enforced, and which is deployed on two campuses and evaluated.

the privacy infrastructure is a distributed system that provides users with the ability to discover and control the collection and use, of video data about their persons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
privacy concerns about computer vision technologies can be mitigated by providing users with the means to control the data that is collected about them.

the infrastructure is a promising approach to support the deployment of privacy enhancing technology and that users' awareness of computer vision applications and their data processing is a crucial step in ensuring privacy.
